scope: Single returned Birger neck/collar repair actually compared on immutable alpha page. Required short broad neck and original small gold collar detail are still not restored. Current raw retained, no approval counted.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: The last two returned versions still fail the actually observed neck/collar requirements. Redraw the head-to-uniform junction: remove the tall straight yellow throat, raise/adapt the actual uniform collar immediately under a curved compact round chin, and reduce exposed neck height to a very short broad transition. Do not simply leave the original yellow stem and retexture it. Fit collar circumference and shoulder lines to the mascot while retaining the original uniform design. Also restore image2's actual small gold collar embroidery/mark arrangement and relative scale: current three large isolated stars on flat black tabs are an oversimplification. Copy only what is visibly present in image2; do not infer a rank or invent crisp named emblems. Preserve source grey side hair and eyebrows, cap, sash/medals, exact pose/expression/crop, full opaque source backdrop and original uniform design.
